brief: Inspect Camden Works 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-781) for any vegetation or obstruction defects, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a unit is identified for pre-event attention (SOP-011). Because the unit has an ONAN cooling type and is unassisted by forced cooling, apply the relevant ambient and cooling de-rating rules if ambient thresholds are exceeded (MG-021).
